verses.pali: “Dasayime, bhikkhave, dhammā parisuddhā pariyodātā, nāññatra sugatavinayā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these ten things are not purified and cleansed apart from the Holy One’s training.

verses.pali: Sammādiṭṭhi, sammāsaṅkappo, sammāvācā, sammākammanto, sammāājīvo, sammāvāyāmo, sammāsati, sammāsamādhi, sammāñāṇaṁ, sammāvimutti—
verses.english: Right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, right immersion, right knowledge, and right freedom.

verses.pali: ime kho, bhikkhave, dasa dhammā parisuddhā pariyodātā, nāññatra sugatavinayā”ti.
verses.english: These ten things are not purified and cleansed apart from the Holy One’s training.”
